# Pumpfun App — pump.fun Solana Memecoin Reference

> How pump.fun works on Solana — launching and trading memecoins on bonding curves, migration to a DEX, fees, and the real risks. Independent, not affiliated with pump.fun.

## Key Facts
- pump.fun: a Solana platform for launching and trading memecoins on bonding curves
- Bonding curve: price is set by a formula that rises as supply is bought and falls as it is sold; no presale, no order book
- Migration: at a set market-cap threshold, liquidity migrates to a decentralized exchange
- Custody: non-custodial — every buy/sell is a signed Solana transaction; you hold your keys
- Costs: Solana network fees + platform trading fee on each trade; small SOL fee to create a token
- HIGH RISK: memecoins are extremely volatile and speculative; most lose most/all value; rug pulls and scams are common; no guaranteed gains
- Connecting a wallet never grants free tokens — "claim free tokens" offers are scams
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by pump.fun
